final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which drops accented letters outright. I didn't touch `vendor/`, since CLAUDE.md says only the platform team upgrades it. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now strips the accents from the title before passing it to `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses a slug, and I didn't look at it. If it calls the vendored `slugify` directly, product URLs probably have the same accent problem.
